ordered_review_passes.finding: Use the scheduled evergreen fallback for mobile chess improvers. The job is to reduce rating anxiety and move readers toward a stable practice comparison. Measure Academy visits and saves only when attributable data exists.
The intent seed is chess rating comparison. Official FIDE and Lichess sources support the pool, formula, time-control, and uncertainty explanation. No search volume or audience size is claimed.
The article avoids a fixed cross-site conversion and distinguishes rating, time-control pool, provisional uncertainty, and XP. It makes no claim that a rating guarantees a result.
Telegram, X, future carousel, and story copy use two hooks and one clear payoff. The selected creative uses the Academy family with contextual pool, clock, and uncertainty icons.

The existing canonical slug is preserved and updated substantively, avoiding a competing article. Metadata answers the query directly. Creative outputs use the shared Studio renderer and retain review-draft status.

analytics_limitations: No article-attributed visits, first-game starts, comparable reach, or Search Console query data were supplied. No performance or ranking outcome is inferred.
